    The graded covering category as a thin category #

    Definition 4.5 (def:graded-covering-category): objects (x, g), morphisms B(x, y)_{g⁻¹h} from (x, g) to (y, h). For a graded family with height data (HomGrading, HeightData) and a representation-finite algebra this is a thin directed k-linear category with a height and finitely many outgoing lines at each object (isThin, hgt_lt, succ_finite).
